title: Motiq Labs — robotics, software and automation
description: Motiq Labs is an engineering team in Zagreb developing robotic systems, computer vision and software for task automation.
hero.lead: We develop robotic systems, computer vision and automation software. We start with your workflow, define the task and test the proposed approach with a prototype.
hero.location: Zagreb, Croatia. Remote and on-site collaboration by arrangement.
figure.title: A robotic task, illustrated
figure.note: An illustration of the process, not footage of a completed system.
boostStrip.label: AI-BOOST
boostStrip.title: Our agricultural robotics proposal was selected for the ADVANCE phase.
services.title: Robotics, software and the systems behind them.
services.lead: We can take on one part of development or connect several disciplines in a single system. We agree the scope, timeline and validation approach before starting.
robotics.label: Robotics
robotics.title: Robotic systems and computer vision
robotics.copy: We develop software that helps robots perceive their surroundings, plan movement and carry out tasks. Our work includes object handling, sorting and agricultural applications.
robotics.detail: We begin with the process, equipment and operating conditions. A prototype or simulation helps us check feasibility before further development. We use ROS and ROS 2 to connect robotic components.
ai.label: Applied AI
ai.title: Software for documents and data
ai.copy: We build tools for document search, data processing and application integration. We use AI where it can help with a specific part of the job.
ai.detail: We agree which sources the system can access and where data is processed. Answers can link to their sources, while actions that need approval remain under your control. We adapt the solution to local or cloud infrastructure.
cloud.label: Infrastructure
cloud.title: Setup, integration and maintenance
cloud.copy: We configure software environments, connect systems and automate updates. We work with local infrastructure and cloud services.
cloud.detail: Within the agreed scope, we configure monitoring, backups and recovery procedures. We hand over documentation and agree any ongoing support.
boost.title: Language-based instructions for agricultural robots.
boost.copy: As part of the AI-BOOST competition, we are developing an approach that turns everyday instructions into a work plan for an agricultural robot. Our proposal was selected for the ADVANCE phase. Prototype development and validation are ongoing.
boost.statusCopy: We are developing planning and action validation. Testing on the target robot is still ahead.
boost.step1Copy: The user specifies what the robot should do and where.
boost.step2Copy: The system creates a plan using actions the robot supports.
boost.step3Copy: The plan must be checked before execution. The system needs to identify requests it cannot carry out.
work.title: What we are working on.
work.lead: Projects at different stages, from collecting data to validating prototypes. These examples describe what we are investigating and what we aim to achieve.
work.aiCopy: We develop assistants that retrieve information from selected sources and help with application workflows. The aim is to reduce searching and repetitive steps, with source checking and approval of actions.
demo.title: An answer with a source you can check.
demo.copy: An assistant searches selected documents and cites where the information comes from. This can help with contracts, technical manuals and internal documentation.
demo.label: Illustrative example
demo.question: What is the payment deadline in this agreement?
demo.answer: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
demo.note: Illustrative content. The answer and agreement are not actual client data.
about.title: Marijan, Ivan and Petar.
about.copy: Motiq Labs brings together three engineers working across different parts of system development. You work directly with us to define the scope, follow progress and review results.
about.marijanCopy: Works on robotic software, computer vision and applied AI. Leads development and project discussions.
about.ivanCopy: Works on infrastructure, software deployment and maintenance, and automation of development and operational workflows.
about.petarCopy: Works on mechanical systems, robot and equipment integration, and testing in real operating conditions.
contact.title: Tell us about the task you want to solve.
contact.copy: Describe how you work today and what you would like to improve. You do not need a finished technical specification for an initial conversation; a description of the problem is enough.
contact.direct: You can also write to us directly:
contact.location: Zagreb, Croatia. Open to collaboration locally and internationally.
form.name: Full name
form.note: Your details open in your email app. You review and send the message yourself.

scene.farmCaption: Example: inspect a row of plants.
story.label: About the name
story.title: A good tool makes the job easier.
story.copy: Motiq takes its name from motika, the Croatian word for a hoe: a simple tool with a clear purpose. We follow the same idea in development: understand the work and build a tool that helps.
agent.title: Motiq AI agent
agent.lead: We are preparing our own AI agent for working with documents, information and business applications.
agent.copy: Our aim is to bring information retrieval and repetitive tasks into one tool, with verifiable sources and approval of important actions.
agent.item1: Working with selected documents and data
agent.item3: Source checking and user approval of actions
agent.note: The product is not yet available. Features and the first testing date will be announced after prototype validation.
